newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes six cents up at 14.86 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes six cents up at 14.86 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed six cents higher at 14.86 ringgit ($5.94) a kg after tracking a strong overnight on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"There was very strong buying right at the start following the high LME," said a trader.

Turnover rose to 89 tonnes from 79 tonnes on Wednesday. There were initial bids for 119 tonnes against offers for 76. Dealers said the local price fetched a premium of $50 against the LME, compared to $100 on Tuesday. Buyers were Europeans and locals.
